SHARED-F-2-S147.title: Consent API and Cross-Service Integration Endpoints
SHARED-F-2-S147.description: Expose consent framework capabilities via internal service interfaces and FastAPI endpoints, enabling other services (lead capture, unknown question handling, debug logging) to check consent status, enforce storage rules, and trigger consent upgrades. Ensure consistent contract usage and safe defaults when consent is missing.
